extraction.name: ArtifactsBench
extraction.description: A benchmark for evaluating LLMs on interactive visual artifacts and visual code generation. It contains 1,825 diverse executable tasks across nine domains and uses staged screenshots plus checklist-guided multimodal judging to assess visual fidelity, interaction, and code quality.
extraction.creator: Tencent Hunyuan Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Candidates were aggregated from expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots, then filtered for completeness, visual quality, licensing, duplication, triviality, and interactivity. Additional steps included de-duplication, prompt rewriting, checklist generation, solvability validation, and standardized execution with staged screenshots.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Candidate artifacts sourced from expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and screenshots used for LLM visual-to-query generation; normalized DOM/CSS/JS and screenshots were also used in de-duplication.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Checklist labels were created by first drafting 10-dimension checklists with an LLM and then refining them by humans for specificity and screenability; humans also verified rewritten prompts and performed spot-checks on sub-category tags. A manually curated 10% seed set was used to calibrate annotators and maintain rubric consistency.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Annotation quality was analyzed via calibration on a 10% manually curated seed set, achieving Cohen’s kappa of at least 0.8 among annotators.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: LLMs were used to draft checklists and rewrite prompts; a lightweight classifier was used to tag sub-categories.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Existing evaluation tools and benchmarks are limited because they emphasize static correctness or non-visual functionality and fail to holistically assess visual fidelity and dynamic interactive behavior.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The benchmark is intended to support development of user-centric generative models and improve evaluation of artifact quality that affects user experience and real-world adoption.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking and evaluating LLMs on interactive visual artifact generation; providing automated, scalable, reproducible scoring and diagnostics for model comparison and progress tracking.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The benchmark, evaluation harness, and baseline results are open-sourced for community use, but no update schedule or deprecation policy is specified.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Difficulty-balanced sampling/splitting was applied post hoc to enforce a target Easy/Medium/Hard distribution of 30%/40%/30%.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Candidates were aggregated from multiple sources and then filtered to remove incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, or non-interactive items; de-duplication and contamination control used MinHash, semantic similarity over prompts/checklists/normalized DOM-CSS-JS, and screenshot perceptual hashing; flagged items were re-authored or discarded; prompts were rewritten for clarity/completeness/executability and verified by humans; underspecified or ambiguous items and brittle-hack solutions were pruned, revised, or removed; execution was standardized with headless Chromium at 1024×768 and deterministic seeds.
